msItem.title: Letter from Thomaso della Paglia to Bartolomeo Concino
msItem.author: Filippo Cavriana
msItem.note: Writing as Thomaso della Paglia from Vienne on the Rhône, Cavriana regrets that on both his visits to Florence he missed the Grand Duke and Concino, and reports partly in cipher. Cardinal Alessandrino has passed through Avignon, and his household says it was badly treated in Florence. Coligny came to court on the 14th with a Huguenot escort and Montmorency as his guard, and is to conclude the marriage of the prince of Navarre with Madame Marguerite; Jeanne d'Albret has gone to Béarn and the baths of Eaux-Chaudes. Pistols are forbidden and the kingdom is at peace; the king asks three million francs of the Gallican church. The Turkish envoy waits at Marseille after the cardinal of Armagnac refused him entry to Avignon. The infantry is disbanded; the Guise are in Lorraine, where the duchess has borne a son; the Huguenots try to send the king's brother out of France. A postscript says the bishop of Dax goes as ambassador to the Turk.

layoutDesc.p: Single column, on three leaves; many passages in numeric cipher, deciphered between the lines by a second hand

handDesc.handNote: Chancery decipherment, written above the cipher groups

projectDesc.p: All places and persons are referenced from placeNames.xml and persNames.xml

editorialDecl.p: Cipher groups are given as read on the photographs, with the interlinear decipherment in add. Each group was checked against the substitution key that the deciphered passages of the corpus yield (a 12, b/v 21 or 18, c 2, d 13, e 31, f 3, g 14, i 4, l 15, m 51, n 5, o 16, p 61, r 17, s 71, t 7, u 18, null 20). Groups whose reading does not decode cleanly are marked unclear.

revisionDesc.change: First transcription, from six photographs of MdP 565, fols. 346r–348r (Apple Notes, folder "ASFi 565"). The placeholder had this letter as MdP 564, fol. 445, dated 28 September; the leaves are foliated 346-348 in MdP 565 and the dateline reads ".18. di settembre". Not yet collated.

Si è prohibito ad ognuno, il portare pistolle, overo altre sorti
d'armi, salvo la spada et pugnale; et così per tutto il
regno, ogni cosa è pacifica, ne si ode più, tu sei ugo
notto, tu sei papista, tu sei un heretico, tu sei un
giudeo; ma si vive in tranquillità, et si attende à fes
te, et al riedificare le case abbattute; onde io credo
che fra questo tempo, come l'Interim di Germania, et
il mal tempo si scaricherà altrove.

Il re ha dimandato, tre millioni di franchi a tutta la chiesa
Gallicana, et di già gli essattori, sono per lo paese; per
cioche il primo termino, che serà per san Martino, di otto
cento mille, comincia ad approssimarsi.

porterà la galera, del conte di Tenda, governatore
di Provenza; Passando presso Avignone, et volendo
vi entrare, il cardinale Armagnac, legato papale
non lo volse admettere, dicendo che la sua religione, nōnon
lo permetteva.
